response.text: {"messages":[{"role":"customer","text":"Hello! Quick question before I order: can I do half one kind of pizza and half another on the same pie?"},{"role":"business","text":"Hi! Let me read that back: one extra large 16-inch half Cheese, half Meat Lovers, and one personal 8-inch Supreme with bacon and thick crust, for pickup under Rosa. When would you like it?"},{"role":"customer","text":"As soon as possible, please. Thank you!"}]}
